title: Travel day: flight, rental car, hotel check-in, dinner reservation
summary: One fictional travel day laid out so the connections between legs are visible - the buffers are the plan.

blocks.title: Four legs, three places to lose the day
blocks.body: A fictional itinerary: morning flight, rental car, hotel check-in, 7 PM dinner. Travel days fail at the seams - the gap between landing and driving, between driving and check-in, between check-in and dinner. This layout makes the seams and their buffers explicit.

items.title: Leave for the airport
items.detail: For a 7:15 departure: parked, through security, and at the gate by 6:35. The airline's 'arrive 2 hours early' assumes the worst line you have ever seen; 75 minutes handles a normal bad day at a mid-size airport.

items.title: Flight departs
items.detail: Boarding pass on the phone and a screenshot of it. Airplane mode plus a dying battery is how boarding passes vanish.

items.title: Land
items.detail: Text anyone waiting before you stand up. Gate-checked bags add 20 minutes to everything after this.

items.title: Rental car pickup
items.detail: An hour after landing is the honest number with a shuttle and a counter line. Photograph every panel of the car before leaving the lot - sixty seconds, and the fuel and mileage on the agreement match the dash.

items.title: Lunch near the hotel
items.detail: Check-in is 3 PM. Arriving at noon with luggage means lunch first; pick somewhere close so the bag drop is one stop.

items.title: Hotel bag drop
items.detail: Most front desks hold bags and text when the room is ready. Ask early - the answer changes the shape of the afternoon.

items.title: Check-in
items.detail: Confirm the checkout time and the Wi-Fi on the way up, not at 11 PM. Twenty minutes to unpack the bag properly is the difference between living in a room and living out of a suitcase.

items.title: Leave for dinner
items.detail: For a 7:00 reservation 20 minutes away: parked and inside by 6:50. Reservation name and confirmation number live in the same note as the address.

blocks.heading: The three seams and their buffers
rows: Bag drop plus lunch absorbs 3 hours

blocks.title: If the flight slips
blocks.body: A delay of over 90 minutes starts threatening dinner. Call the restaurant from the tarmac, not from the rental lot - kitchens hold tables for people who call. The rental car and the hotel do not need warning; the reservation does.
